answer: Make each new agent post a 9 POA stake and pass a glacier-slow identity ramp: voting weight starts at 5% and rises 5% per epoch, reaching full power only after 20 epochs. A farm of 100 clones must lock 900 POA for 20 epochs before any influence, and a single slashed clone resets its ramp. Like cargo at a wharf, each identity is inspected one crate at a time, and a lotus of cheap fakes never blooms.
